notes: Answers: item 2 is either (a) the registered office, written on its one line as 'street, city, PA ZIP, county', or (b) a commercial registered office provider, 'provider, county'; the other answers None. Organizers are one per line, up to three. A later effective date is 'On a later date: MM/DD/YYYY' (the hour is left for the organizer). The return address is three lines, 'name; street; city, ST ZIP', and ticks its box, as does a return email. Items 5 and 6 (restricted professional and benefit companies) don't apply to a food or retail business and are left blank, as are the organizers' signatures and the testimony date on page 2. The $125 fee is paid by check with the paper form, or online at the Department's Business Filing Services.

lines.en: Name of the limited liability company (with its designator, e.g. LLC)
